name: prweb_latest_releases
description: Latest press releases from PRWeb's site-wide RSS feed (source: prweb.com, Cision's small-business wire). Returns headline, issuer, published time, excerpt and industry tags for each release, newest first. Covers the ~20 most recent releases across all categories — not PRWeb's full archive.

since_hours.description: Only return releases published within the last N hours (optional).

name: prweb_search_releases
description: Keyword/company search over PRWeb's current site-wide feed (source: prweb.com). Matches against headline, issuer name, excerpt and industry tags. Searches only the live rolling ~20-item window each call — not a historical archive.

query.description: Company name or keyword to match.

name: prweb_get_release
description: Fetch one specific PRWeb release by its URL (source: prweb.com), as returned by prweb_latest_releases or prweb_search_releases. Re-fetches the live feed each call — a release that has scrolled off the current ~20-item window will not be found.

url.description: The release URL (from a prior prweb tool call).
